examples/demo-kit/test/activity-undo.test.ts::case 2: a partial verdict is ONE 'Partly undid' row, and the entry reads undone
examples/demo-kit/test/activity-undo.test.ts::case 3 (guard): a void applyUndo is today's undo, unchanged
examples/demo-kit/test/activity-undo.test.ts::case 4: {through:true} undoes the blocker then the row, newest first, in one transaction
examples/hirelane/test/actions.test.ts::case 5: undoing an older move after a newer one is refused, names the blocker, and offers Undo both
examples/hirelane/test/actions.test.ts::case 6: Undo both walks the two moves back, newest first, and both rows read undone
examples/hirelane/test/actions.test.ts::case 7: undoing a move after a decision is refused with no chain to offer, and the decision stands
examples/hirelane/test/actions.test.ts::case 8: undoing propose_slots after a gated send booked one is a partial undo, and says so once
deviations_from_card: One commit instead of two (kit + hirelane together, ADR and changelog in it). history.test.ts left untouched: the toast cases (5, 7, 8) are asserted in actions.test.ts through undoToastFor. Grew the write set by one test file: examples/hirelane/test/run.test.ts, whose source-regex pinned the literal `undoAction(id)` and now accepts `undoAction(id, options)`. Three existing hirelane tests that pinned the old behaviour ('left the stage alone' rows, the hand-logged partial row, ok:true for a refused undo) were rewritten as cases 5-8. Case 7 uses an Offer decision as the card says (the old test used Rejected). The History band (History.tsx) needed no change: a refused row is no longer marked undone, so it keeps its Undo.
notes: Kit contract for tidycrm-blocks-ui/B: undoActivity(db, id, applyUndo, options?) - applyUndo's return type widened to UndoVerdict (void | {refused, blockedBy?} | {partial}); UndoResult gained optional blockedBy, partial, alsoUndone; options {through?}. All additive; void applyUndo behaves exactly as before. Refusal rollback uses SAVEPOINT dk_undo_<n> so it works inside a caller's withTx. New types UndoVerdict/UndoOptions/UndoAnswer exported from @athena/demo-kit/activity (UndoAnswer from types.ts for client use). ActivityLog's onUndo is now (id, options?) => Promise<UndoAnswer>; existing (id) => {ok, reason?} callers type-check unchanged. ADR 0156 claimed under the lock. No sibling reds seen. Follow-up (not built): ledgerbox's sent-reminder undo can return {refused} instead of a silent no-op.
